narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The largest number that divides thirty six is thirty six, so thirty six wins.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Try thirty six bags for the red marbles, and some marbles are left over.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>It must divide both counts exactly, so that slip is struck.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, divide both numbers by your answer and look for whole numbers.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Three hundred and six divided by eighteen is seventeen, and thirty six divided by eighteen is two.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Three and two also divide both, but they are smaller than eighteen.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the check lines 306 / 18 = 17 and 36 / 18 = 2 appear with ticks; the choices 3 and 2 are marked smaller

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip says thirty six wins because it is the biggest choice that divides thirty six. It does not divide three hundred and six exactly, so it fails.
